# `set_is_favorite`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Add or remove image files in the favorites database.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe1d00, AddImages @0xae600 (64-bit build) |

Params must be an object with name (string or array of strings) and is_favorite (boolean); optional storage selects the storage the names are relative to. The database work is synchronous. A success reply has integer result 0; error paths omit result. The app sends name as a string array without storage.

Side effects: Updates the favorites database for the collected full file names. Does not emit an event or an image. Database transaction atomicity and file existence validation are unresolved.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_is_favorite"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Object params only (any other type, including absent, is rejected with 102). No positional alternative. [READ] |
| `params.storage` | string | no | - | Storage to resolve the filenames against. Names are model dependent (emmc, sd, udisk), matched case-insensitively. Absent or non-string silently uses the current image path. An unrecognized name is not ignored: it fails with 204. The storage connected/mounted state is not checked. [READ] |
| `params.name` | any | yes | - | Image file name or array of names. A string becomes base path plus that string. In an array, non-string elements are silently skipped and an empty resulting list is accepted. Any other top-level type, or absence, is rejected with 100. No length, traversal, extension, existence or count limit is checked. [READ] |
| `params.is_favorite` | boolean | yes | - | Strict JSON boolean (integer 0/1 is rejected with 102). True adds the files to the favorites database, false removes them. No default. Checked after the names are collected. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 102 | Params not an object, or is_favorite absent or not a boolean | `invalid params` |
| 100 | name absent or neither string nor array | `invalid request` |
| 204 | storage names no known storage (including unrecognized names) | `out of limit` |
| 531 | Adding or removing the favorites fails | `operate database fail` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, mark:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"set_is_favorite","params":{"name":["Example_001.fit"],"is_favorite":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_is_favorite","result":0,"code":0,"id":41}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_is_favorite","error":"operate database fail","code":531,"id":42}
```
